name: @vicsee/mcp-server

tools.name: vicsee_list_models
tools.description: List available VicSee models with their capabilities and credit costs. Call this first to find a model id to pass to vicsee_generate. Optionally filter by media type.

tools.name: vicsee_generate
tools.description: Create an AI image or video with VicSee. Generation is ASYNCHRONOUS: this returns a task `id` immediately, then poll `vicsee_get_task` with that id until status is "completed" (the result URL appears in result.url) or "failed". Use vicsee_list_models to pick a `model` and see its valid options. For image-to-video / image-to-image, pass source images in `image_urls`. For reference-to-video models (e.g. "seedance-2-0-reference-to-video"), pass references in reference_image_urls / reference_video_urls / reference_audio_urls and refer to them positionally in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2, … IMAGE inputs (image_urls, reference_image_urls) may be a public https URL, a local file path (this server reads and base64-encodes it for you), or a base64 data URI. VIDEO/AUDIO inputs (reference_video_urls, reference_audio_urls) must be public https URLs. For video-edit models (e.g. "happyhorse-video-edit"), pass the source clip in video_url and optionally set audio_setting ("auto" or "origin").

model.description: Model id from vicsee_list_models, e.g. "nano-banana-pro-text-to-image" or "seedance-2-0-text-to-video"

image_urls.description: Source image(s) for image-to-video / image-to-image. Each may be a public https URL, a local file path (this server reads and base64-encodes it for you), or a base64 data URI.

reference_image_urls.description: Reference-to-video only: up to 7 reference images. Each may be a public https URL, a local file path (this server reads and base64-encodes it for you), or a base64 data URI. Refer to them in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2, …

reference_video_urls.description: Reference-to-video only: up to 3 public https video URLs (2-15s each, ≤15s total).

reference_audio_urls.description: Reference-to-video only: up to 3 public https audio URLs.

video_url.description: Video-edit models (e.g. "happyhorse-video-edit") only: one public https video URL, 3-15s, to edit.

audio_setting.description: Video-edit models only: "auto" (regenerate audio) or "origin" (keep the source audio).

duration.description: Video length in seconds (e.g. 5, 6, 10, 15) — video models only

extra.description: Any additional model-specific params (see the model's options from vicsee_list_models)

tools.name: vicsee_get_task
tools.description: Poll a generation or upscale task by its id. status is one of "pending" | "processing" | "queued" | "completed" | "failed". When "completed", the media URL is in result.url (videos/images) or result.songs (music). When "failed", details are in error. Poll every few seconds until completed or failed.

task_id.description: The task id returned by vicsee_generate / vicsee_upscale_*

tools.name: vicsee_upscale_image
tools.description: Upscale a publicly accessible image (JPEG/PNG/WebP). Asynchronous: returns a task id — poll vicsee_get_task until completed. upscale_factor defaults to "2".

tools.name: vicsee_upscale_video
tools.description: Upscale a publicly accessible video (MP4/MOV/MKV, up to 60s). Asynchronous: returns a task id — poll vicsee_get_task until completed. upscale_factor defaults to "2".

tools.name: vicsee_get_credits
tools.description: Get the current VicSee credit balance for the configured API key.

tools.name: vicsee_upload
tools.description: Upload a LOCAL file (image, video, or audio) from this machine and get back a public https URL. Use the returned url as an input for vicsee_generate — e.g. drop it into reference_image_urls for a reference-to-video storyboard, or image_urls for image-to-video. PREFER this over inline base64 for references: large base64 strings get truncated in tool-call output and the model rejects them. The file uploads directly to storage; only its public URL comes back.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local file (image/video/audio) on this machine.

stderr: VicSee MCP server running on stdio.
